declared.title: Exact 16-PTY profile: admissions within 100 ms, every delivery and armed exit event exact

stdout.text: <ready and report lines are parsed, not stored: the ready line carries the bearer>

cases.summary: Sixteen one-line /usr/bin/head -n 1 terminals on one server (ideal-state.md:259 profile). An exit wait per terminal is armed on its own connection before any input (fenced by a terminal.list reply on that connection, which the server reads after the sixteen waits). All sixteen input.send admissions must then answer within 100 ms; every exit wait reports matched (armed before the exit; a late wait would answer already_satisfied) and every echo is delivered exactly at its own admission cursor. The 100 ms bound on deliveries and exit events is the declared capacity/sixteen-latency.
